notes.title: Where’s Gangs of Rikton At?
notes.content: [h3]Hello everyone,[/h3][p]It’s been a while since I last gave you an update, and I wanted to take a moment to speak openly with you.[/p][p][b]The project is not abandoned.[/b] It’s still in development. These past years have been a long road, sometimes complicated, but the game is moving forward—slowly, but surely.[/p][p]I understand that such a long silence might have looked like an abandonment, and I sincerely thank you if you’re still here reading this. Your patience and interest mean a lot, and it’s for you that I want to see this through to the end.[/p][p]The game has changed a lot since its demo at Steam NextFest back in… October 2021. Yeah, time flies. I’m a solo developer and [i]Gangs of Rikton[/i] is my very first game, and like most first times, I made plenty of mistakes. I’ve changed my mind a lot on gameplay elements, and since 2022 I haven’t had as much time to work on the project as I wanted. So, what will the game look like?[/p][p][/p][h2][u]Inspirations and Expected Gameplay[/u][/h2][p]As you might guess, the game is partly inspired by [i]Drug Dealer Simulator[/i] and [i]Schedule I[/i], but also (and most of all) by [i]Scarface: The World Is Yours[/i]. On the story side, the main inspiration is the [i]Breaking Bad[/i] series. Therefore, only synthetic drugs will be present in the game (ecstasy, methamphetamine, fentanyl), with the player primarily taking on the role of a cook.[/p][p]Just like in [i]Breaking Bad[/i], the real challenge will be selling your product. You’ll have several options: direct sales to clients downtown, bulk deals with crazy gang leaders (think Tuco Salamanca), or using a prostitution network. But the most lucrative option will also be the most violent: taking control of fixed selling points, then entire neighborhoods, to dominate the market. This path will lead you straight into gang wars, where you’ll face ambushes in the city, assaults on your property, and the need to defend your dealers (yourself, or with hired henchmen). Rival gangs won’t sit idle; they’ll fight among themselves or even unite against you if you become too powerful (making for an intense endgame).[/p][p]So, the core of the gameplay is: chemistry, logistics, managing your crew, and gang warfare (with the police, of course). As for the map size, Rikton City is slightly larger than Los Santos in [i]GTA San Andreas[/i].[/p][p][/p][h2][u]Release Date?[/u][/h2][p]Unfortunately, I can’t give one yet, as there’s still a lot of work to do. But I think early access will happen in less than a year (at least, that’s my hope). In the coming months, I’ll be updating the Steam page description and visuals (which are completely outdated). I’ll also be posting a few devlogs to showcase the major features. And when a new trailer drops, that will mean release is very close.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you again for your support and trust.[/p][p][b]Trijis Games[/b][/p]

notes.title: Early Access News !
notes.content:
[h3]Hi there ![/h3]

It's been a long time since I communicated on the game. Between the presentation of the demo and the month of April, the gameplay of the game has been completely redesigned and redone. It is now more coherent and richer, at the expense of secondary elements that have been removed.

The graphics have received a major update. The map has also been completely redone with new, much prettier assets. However it is not finished yet.

But since May, development has slowed considerably. For those who don't know, I'm the only one doing the game, and I had been able to work on it full-time since September 2020 thanks to my savings. But since May, I can no longer. So I took a job to replenish my coffers. I'm on vacation this month and I fully intend to finish what remains to be done to release the game in early access.

[h2]Early Access Content[/h2]

I want to reassure you, 95% of the gameplay will be present. There will surely be some bugs but the game is already well debugged, especially thanks to my few loyal testers. There will surely be a need to balance two or three things here and there.

This is the city that will not be finished. In fact there is only 50% of it. Of the six districts, only three are done (and still not completely at this time).

So I'm planning the first three districts and all the gameplay for early access. This will represent ten hours of play.

[h2]Early access and roadmap[/h2]

The game will be released in August. I can't say exactly when yet but probably towards the end of the month. In addition to small updates to debug and balance the game, it will receive four or five big updates. The first three will each add a district and unlock new business opportunities and upgrades for the player. The fourth update will add a villa and a final challenge to the game, which will put your gang leader skills to the test to finish the game.

The fifth update remains secret for now. I'll see if it's needed or not when the first four updates are released, and I'll tell you about it then (or sooner if I notice its need first).

[h2]Communication, demo and devblogs[/h2]

As you may have noticed, communication is not my forte. Between now and the game's release, I plan to do three or four dev blogs so you know what to expect. I also know as a gamer that there is nothing better than trying out a game to find out if it is worth buying or not. This is why a demo with two hours of gameplay will be available at the same time as the game in order to give you an opinion ;)

Thank you all and see you soon for a first devblog !
